description.value: A floating pier in Vancouver that doubles as a natural waterslide into the ocean, accessible only in summer and only during high tide. With a capacity of one, it offers a simple and memorable swim experience at what is likely Second Beach near Stanley Park. It is a free, publicly accessible curiosity that cycling visitors to the seawall would pass directly.
